name: Ja'den
source:
"She is the 'sister' of Maj'hel. She's an extremely sexual individual. Alluring, seductive, but a very tough opponent if taken on in either verbal or physical capacity.
Her full lips, blue eyes, voluptuous body and mane-like hair attract suitors of any kind to her, but it's her personality that brings the main attraction. 'Family' is her most precious treasure.
She has a secret that not even the closest people to her know."

[In-game description]
